summary: The note describes Lady Li, a cousin of Wang Jipeng through their mothers and fathers' families. Her father was the official Li Min, a chancellor under Wang Lin (Wang Jipeng's father, Wang Yanjun). The date of her marriage to Wang Jipeng is unknown, but she was referred to as his original princess and later held the title Lady of Liang.
one_line: Lady Li, a cousin and original princess of Wang Jipeng, whose father Li Min served as chancellor under Wang Lin.
key_facts: Lady Li was a cousin of Wang Jipeng.
Lady Li's mother was a sister of Wang Yanjun, the father of Wang Jipeng.
Wang Yanjun was known as Wang Lin during his reign as emperor.
Lady Li's father was the official Li Min (李敏).
Li Min served as a chancellor during the reign of Wang Lin.
It is not known when Lady Li married Wang Jipeng.
Historical accounts referred to Lady Li as Wang Jipeng's "original princess" (元妃).
The marriage was probably during the time Wang Jipeng was the Prince of Fu under his father.
Lady Li eventually carried the title of Lady of Liang.
